summary: Tests-writing phase for issue #39: committed a solver-parity corpus harness (seed corpus + permanent parity tests over WeightedSquaredErrorScorer and the production CompositionSolver path, covering ties, exclusions, zero-weight channels, and weight flips), wire-contract pinning tests for the /api/v1 endpoints the generated-client migration must preserve, and corpus-consumption docs. Corpus expectations were cross-verified with an independent reference implementation of the documented algorithm. swift test could not be executed in this container (no Swift toolchain; bin/lint skips with exit 0 by design) — the new tests must be run on a macOS/Swift host. Implementation deliverables (swift-openapi-generator dependency, Package.swift changes, PaletteAPIClient migration, README edit) are out of scope for this tests-only phase per the phase rules.

acceptance_criteria.description: Add a solver parity test target that loads the committed corpus and asserts WeightedSquaredErrorScorer selections match expected outputs exactly, including tie cases

references.note: 11 cases (2 exact ties, 3 exclusion cases, 1 all-excluded, 1 all-five-channel weights, 2 weight-flip cases, Elixir 0.205 doctest); expectations cross-verified with an independent reference implementation
testScorerSelectionsMatchCorpusIncludingTies — scorer-level exact selection, score within 1e-9, excluded set equality
testProductionSolverSelectionsMatchCorpus — replays every case through CompositionSolver fast path
Corpus integrity: decodes, unique ids, must contain tie/exclusion/unmatched/all-channel coverage, canonical lighting keys, parseable hex
